支援模組：

  • Biomes O' Plenty
  • Frostiful
  • L_Ender's_Cataclysm
  • Undergarden
  • Twilight Forest
  • Illager Invasion
  • Geode Plus
  • Galosphere Trims
  • Deep Aether
  • Aether Redux
  • Upgrade Aquatic
  • Neapolitan
  • Atmospheric
  • Alex's Caves
  • Blue Skies
  • Wilderness
  • Jaden's Nether Expansion
  • Goety
  • Eternal Starlight
